scope: Five source-confirmed iteration03 question repairs; synthetic regression evidence only.

repaired.explicit_precedence: First select insufficient if billable_item or support_bundle is missing, empty, or cannot be related to the named item. For interpretable evidence, contradictory_support takes precedence over missing_required_support, which takes precedence over supported. A missing required record does not erase an explicit material conflict. How does support_bundle relate to the stated billable_item? Judge whether the named records support the item, lack a needed stated record, contradict it, or are insufficient. Do not decide whether to invoice, whether work is payable, or whether any party approved payment.

First select insufficient if operation_description or replay_trace is missing, empty, or cannot establish the operation and relevant invocation scope. Within that scope, duplicate_effect_risk takes precedence over both single_effect_demonstrated and no_effect_before_side_effect. Then select single_effect_demonstrated when repeated invocations produce one persistent effect, even if another invocation stopped before its effect; select no_effect_before_side_effect only when no relevant persistent effect is shown. Preserve the observed trace even when risk takes precedence. What replay or idempotence evidence is explicitly shown by operation_description and replay_trace? Classify the observed or stated effect only. Do not authorize another replay, assume an idempotency key works, or infer side effects absent from the trace.

First select unverifiable if selection_request or candidate_manifest is missing, empty, has irreconcilable scope declarations, or cannot establish an applicable candidate universe. For an interpretable declaration, ambiguous_or_duplicate_candidates takes precedence over either completeness label. Otherwise an explicitly known incomplete shortlist selects bounded_but_expandable, not exhaustive_with_provenance; only a complete applicable universe with source identities and no unresolved duplicates selects exhaustive_with_provenance. What coverage status is explicitly described by candidate_manifest for selection_request? Classify the candidate-set declaration, not which candidate should win. Do not infer missing candidates or select a value.

First select insufficient if query or candidate_corpus is missing, empty, or cannot establish the relevant corpus scope. For interpretable evidence, preserve_conflict_for_review takes precedence over expand_or_retrieve and rank_eligible. Without material conflict, a known incomplete shortlist selects expand_or_retrieve even if it contains an answer-bearing candidate; only answer-bearing evidence without the named conflict or expansion condition selects rank_eligible. What retrieval-controller route is supported by the stated query and candidate_corpus coverage? This selects the next bounded workflow branch, not an answer or source authority.

First select insufficient if candidate_pair, field_evidence, or merge_policy is missing, empty, or cannot establish a policy route. If the supplied policy and explicit identity evidence establish distinct entities, keep_separate takes precedence over related, matching, incomplete, or conflicting descriptive fields. Otherwise select curator_review when the policy requires review of unresolved conflict or ambiguity; this takes precedence over apparent alignment. Select independent_identity_check only when an applicable policy requires that check and no preceding condition applies. What merge-handling route is supported by candidate_pair, field_evidence, and merge_policy? Classify the route only. Do not merge, edit, or delete an entity.

pair_review.host_review: Each pair was checked against the written missing-first and precedence rules. Low-confidence CT08 judgments are retained; no retry or qualification claim.
